author: Russell Brand
description:
There's a reason we feel more isolated than ever, even while being more "connected" online than any generation before us. Russell and his guest break down what's actually driving that, and why community might be the real way through it.

Order my new book 'How to Become Christian in 7 Days' at https://bit.ly/russellbook2

WATCH LIVE Mon Wed Fri: https://bit.ly/russellbrand-rumble

All links: https://linktr.ee/RussellBrand
title: Is community the real protection from all this?

author: Russell Brand
description: In this Sunday Service with The Brands Laura and Russell explain their previous absence, worship to the tune of Cockney-Rock band Chas n’ Dave, discuss the book of Enoch and the significance of spiritual warfare and Mary’s redeeming conception in light of the fallen angel’s corruption of the “daughters of men”. Also Saint Philip Neary, playful saint gets a shout out as Russell describes climbing the wall into Brompton Oratory, London. Homeschool Mom’s are given some book recommendations too
title: Sunday Service 15
